content.text:
* Continuous-time wide-input SKY130 OTA; two gain stages and Miller compensation
.subckt DUT VINP VINN VOUT VDD VSS IBIAS
* 10 uA reference and PMOS bias conversion
XBN IBIAS IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBC BP IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBP BP BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBCT BPT IBIAS VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=10 l=1 nf=1 m=1
XBPT BPT BPT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=60 l=0.3 nf=1 m=1
* Matched 0.31 DC input attenuation; 1.2 Mohm total input resistance
* Capacitive lead and matched PMOS shunt capacitors
RIP VINP IP 828k
RGP IP VSS 372k
RIN VINN IN 828k
RGN IN VSS 372k
CIP VINP IP 3.6p
CIN VINN IN 3.6p
XCP VDD IP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=6.05 nf=1 m=1
XCN VDD IN VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=6.05 nf=1 m=1
* PMOS differential first stage with a separate low-overdrive tail bias
XPT ST BPT VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=7
XP1 D1 IN ST VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=7
XP2 G2 IP ST VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.3 nf=1 m=7
XN1 D1 D1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
XN2 G2 D1 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=3
* Common-source output stage; 20:1 PMOS reference mirror
* Output bias exceeds input-tail bias to avoid deep large-signal overdrive
XPO VOUT BP VDD VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 w=20 l=1 nf=1 m=20
XNO VOUT G2 VSS VSS sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w=100 l=0.5 nf=1 m=7
* Miller compensation and series zero resistor
RC G2 CM 2k
CC CM VOUT 2.6p
.ends DUT
